newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunis bourse index little changed in lower volume.
newsitem.headline: Tunis bourse index little changed in lower volume.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange index on Thursday closed slightly up 0.08 percent in lower trade, bourse sources said.
The 31-share index closed at 455.51 points, up from 455.13 on Wednesday.
Total volume was 2.51 million dinars against 16.06 million dinars over the previous session. Over-the-counter exchanges amounted to 1.79 million dinars.
Chemical firm Alkimia was up 0.5 dinar to 40.5 dinars. Detergents firm SPCD rose 0.4 dianr to 29.
UIB bank advanced 0.14 dinar to 11.45 dinars.
Coca and beer bottler SFBT was down 0.8 dinar to 80.2 dinars.
BTEI bank eased 0.14 dinar to 21.86 dinars. ($1=1.1055 dinar)
